% Written by `lab paper game-rating`; do not edit by hand.
\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{lL}
\toprule
Feature & Description \\
\midrule
\texttt{ply} & The ply (half-move) number of the position in the game. \\
\texttt{log\_clock} & The time left on the mover's clock, as log(1 + seconds). \\
\texttt{log\_opponent\_clock} & The time left on the opponent's clock, as log(1 + seconds). \\
\texttt{log\_spent} & The time spent on the move, as log(1 + seconds). \\
\texttt{win\_before} & The mover's win probability implied by the engine evaluation of the position, in percent. \\
\texttt{loss} & The mover's win probability before the move minus that after it, in percentage points. \\
\texttt{legal\_moves} & The number of legal moves the mover has. \\
\texttt{capture} & Whether the move played was a capture. \\
\texttt{check} & Whether the move played gave check. \\
\texttt{castle\_own\_king} & Whether the mover still has the right to castle kingside. \\
\texttt{castle\_own\_queen} & Whether the mover still has the right to castle queenside. \\
\texttt{castle\_opp\_king} & Whether the opponent still has the right to castle kingside. \\
\texttt{castle\_opp\_queen} & Whether the opponent still has the right to castle queenside. \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
